segments.text:
V. 26.
Jeſus ſaith—Haſting to ſatisfy her Deſire, before his Diſciples came. I am He—Our LORD did not ſpeak this ſo plainly to the Jews, who were 〈◊〉 full of the Meſſiah's temporal Kingdom. If He had, many would doubtleſs have taken up Arms in his Favour, and others have accuſed him to the Roman Governor. Yet He did in Effect declare the Thing, tho' he denied the particular Title. For in a Multitude of Places He repreſented Himſelf, both as the Son of Man, and as the Son of GOD: Both which Expreſſions were generally underſtood by the Jews as peculiarly applicable to the Meſſiah.
